title: The Backward Man
text: A man walks toward you backward, heels first, never stumbling. He speaks your words a breath before you say them, in your own voices. He has come from where you are going, and from the look on the back of his head, he did not like it.

options.label: The wisest asks him what lies ahead, though they may not like the answer.

outcomes.text: He tells it backward, word by word. It only makes sense later, once it is already happening.
He answers with the wisest's own scream, a breath before they make it. They spend the rest of the day waiting to make it.

options.label: Walk backward with him, and trust he knows the way he came.

outcomes.text: The way behind becomes the way ahead until the ground forgets which is which. For a while, so do you.

options.label: The Changed one meets his eyes, one stranger to another.

outcomes.text: He sees that they are already other. He steps aside without looking back.
